findings.stock_base_history: Public .13 called get_price_history, real four broker adapters expose get_daily_candles. Price indicators and average volume could be absent. Fixed actual contract and validated completed bars; no threshold change.
findings.paper_tp_sl: PAPER stores net_pnl_percent; exit policy expected pnl_rate and silently read zero. Fixed fresh net percentage mapping; invalid valuation holds rather than liquidating.
findings.kis_ema200: KIS official API caps each response at 100 rows, inherited implementation fetched one page. Added bounded date-backwards pagination for up to 500 rows, paced reads and repeated/invalid page rejection.
findings.seven_days: Existing default promotion gate, not PAPER or base-trading start delay. >=3 valid closes + active permission-window sum >=7 days + no guard violations. Not measured engine uptime or statistical optimality proof.
findings.pause: Existing start/stop_paper and activate/deactivate preserved. UI clarifies applied strategy pause/reactivation. Deactivation excludes next pool lookup; in-flight evaluation/reserved/submitted orders are not atomically canceled. Existing position exit plans/evidence remain.
findings.temporary_expiry: Manual apply/pause exists. Time-scheduled expiry/resume is not implemented; STUDIO-TTL follow-up requires persistent expiry and submission boundary tests.
findings.customer_mode: User confirmed both Kiwoom and KIS use PAPER (2026-10-14); current hold message still pending. This confirms scope, not individual root cause or installed-app recovery.
findings.other_users: No other user reactions or aggregate deployment feedback evidence supplied.
findings.kiwoom_previous_price: Optional prev_close quote field absence produced zero momentum contribution. Added official OpenAPI+ GetMasterLastPrice fallback, preserving valid quote fields and explicit missing/source evidence. No REST contract substitution or inferred prices. Synthetic before/after verified; real OCX not run.
